correctness.rationale: Independent alternating coupon streams prove the equality with P(C_b>=C_a); finite-state recursion independently checks exact probabilities across 100 part pairs, and the geometric-stage stochastic comparison proves strict sign. Inclusion-exclusion/Bonnferroni proves Gumbel weak convergence; independence gives logistic balance. The characteristic function of the single geometric stage with success 1/n gives an integrable O(t^-2) envelope, so Fourier inversion and Plancherel yield lim n P(C_n=C_n_prime)=1/4. Algebra then gives the 1/(8n) TV constant, with all endpoints treated.

value.rationale: This is a natural cover-tour terminal-site statistic with a strict counterintuitive opposite-part advantage on balanced bipartite graphs. The unique n/log n competition scale and explicit logistic profile quantify near-balance bias, and the 1/(8n) full-distribution total-variation constant gives an exact asymptotic nonuniformity rate not settled by qualitative uniformity classification. Each answers a motivated graph-specific comparison rather than a parameter substitution.
